title: Replace shared-memory warp-final reduce with shuffle-only (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
Single warp of 32 threads reducing 32 partial sums to one total in out[0].
smem_waves must be exactly 0 -- a shared-memory tree reduction (with __syncthreads()) computes the same correct sum but measures smem_waves=17 on this fixture, failing the gate.
